lines.translation: To the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, shall be rid of the cycle of birth and death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਮਨੋਰਥੁ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਭੇਟਤ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aas manorath pooran hovai bhetat gur darasaaiaa jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: His hopes and desires are fulfilled, when he gains the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: agam agochar kichh mit nahee jaanee ||
lines.translation: The limits of the Inaccessible and Unfathomable Lord cannot be known.
The seekers, the Siddhas, those beings of miraculous spiritual powers, and the spiritual teachers, all meditate on Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੁਦੀ ਮਿਟੀ ਚੂਕਾ ਭੋਲਾਵਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: khudee mitee chookaa bholaavaa gur man hee mahi pragataaiaa jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: Thus, their egos are erased, and their doubts are dispelled. The Guru has enlightened their minds. ||3||
I chant the Name of the Lord, the Treasure of bliss,
Joy, salvation, intuitive peace and poise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੫॥੩੨॥
lines.transliteration: hoi kripaal suaamee apanaa naau naanak ghar mahi aaiaa jeeu ||4||25||32||
lines.translation: When my Lord and Master blessed me with His Mercy, O Nanak, then His Name entered the home of my mind. ||4||25||32||
Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
Hearing of You, I live.
You are my Beloved, my Lord and Master, Utterly Great.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਕਰਤਬ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਓਟ ਗੋੁਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tumare karatab tum hee jaanahu tumaree ot goupaalaa jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: You alone know Your Ways; I grasp Your Support, Lord of the World. ||1||
Singing Your Glorious Praises, my mind is rejuvenated.
Hearing Your Sermon, all filth is removed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੇਟਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਸਦਾ ਜਪਉ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bhetat sa(n)g saadh sa(n)tan kai sadaa japau daiaalaa jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I meditate forever on the Merciful Lord. ||2||
I dwell on my God with each and every breath.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਨਿ ਧਾਰਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ih mat gur prasaad man dhaarau ||
lines.translation: This understanding has been implanted within my mind, by Guru's Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ਸਰਬ ਮਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tumaree kripaa te hoi pragaasaa sarab maiaa pratipaalaa jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: By Your Grace, the Divine Light has dawned. The Merciful Lord cherishes everyone. ||3||
True, True, True is that God.
Forever, forever and ever, He Himself is.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਲਿਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੩੩॥
lines.transliteration: chalit tumaare pragat piaare dekh naanak bhae nihaalaa jeeu ||4||26||33||
lines.translation: Your Playful Ways are revealed, O my Beloved. Beholding them, Nanak is enraptured. ||4||26||33||
Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
By His Command, the rain begins to fall.
The Saints and friends have met to chant the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਠਾਢਿ ਪਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: seetal saa(n)t sahaj sukh paaiaa thaadh paaee prabh aape jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: Serene tranquility and peaceful ease have come; God Himself has brought a deep and profound peace. ||1||
God has produced everything in great abundance.
Granting His Grace, God has satisfied all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: daat karahu mere daataaraa jee ja(n)t sabh dhraape jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: Bless us with Your Gifts, O my Great Giver. All beings and creatures are satisfied. ||2||
True is the Master, and True is His Name.
By Guru's Grace, I meditate forever on Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭੈ ਕਾਟੇ ਮੋਹਾ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran bhai kaate mohaa binase sog sa(n)taape jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: The fear of birth and death has been dispelled; emotional attachment, sorrow and suffering have been erased. ||3||
With each and every breath, Nanak praises the Lord.
Meditating in remembrance on the Name, all bonds are cut away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸ ਕਰੀ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਜਾਪੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੩੪॥
lines.transliteration: pooran aas karee khin bheetar har har har gun jaape jeeu ||4||27||34||
lines.translation: One's hopes are fulfilled in an instant, chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||4||27||34||
Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
Come, dear friends, Saints and companions:
let us join together and sing the Glorious Praises of the Inaccessible and Infinite Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਤ ਸੁਣਤ ਸਭੇ ਹੀ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਸੋ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਮ ਕੀਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gaavat sunat sabhe hee mukate so dhiaaeeai jin ham keee jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: Those who sing and hear these praises are liberated, so let us meditate on the One who created us. ||1||
The sins of countless incarnations depart,
and we receive the fruits of the mind's desires.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਭਸੁ ਕਉ ਦੀਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: simar saahib so sach suaamee rijak sabhas kau deee jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: So meditate on that Lord, our True Lord and Master, who gives sustenance to all. ||2||
Chanting the Naam, all pleasures are obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਭਉ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh bhau binasai har har dhiaaeeai ||
lines.translation: All fears are erased, meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸੋ ਪਾਰਗਿਰਾਮੀ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲੇ ਥੀਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jin seviaa so paaragiraamee kaaraj sagale theee jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: One who serves the Lord swims across to the other side, and all his affairs are resolved. ||3||
I have come to Your Sanctuary;
if it pleases You, unite me with You.
